owner_and_capability: Test support — the request, response, router and claims helpers of HTTP adapter tests leave api/testutil for api/testutil/routetest (test-support) and the shared fixture catalog test, so a route suite that composes no services no longer links the legacy service graph; a further #2748 step for api/testutil.
affected_tables: No table: the change moves test helpers only; the switched suites read and write the same rows through the same fixtures.
atomic_cutover: One test-support-only change. The request, response and router helpers move unchanged from api/testutil/helpers.go to api/testutil/routetest, classified test-support in policy.json. The claims, token and identity-context helpers (Claims, MintTestJWT, the *TestClaims builders, TestTokenAuth, AuthenticationContext, WithAuthenticatedContext, ClaimsFromContext, the MFA enrollment claims, OpaqueCapabilityFingerprint, WithRefreshToken) move unchanged to test/route_claims.go, which uses the test package's existing legacy/jwt edge; routetest re-exports them and adds WithClaims, WithPermissions and ExecuteWithAuth*. api/testutil re-exports every moved name, keeps the device and staff principal helpers and the module builders, and no longer imports legacy/jwt. Eight suites that use only these helpers import routetest instead of api/testutil by changing the import and selector only.
tests: The eight switched suites (api/absence-types, api/operator, modules/communication/http/parentannouncements, modules/delivery/http/notifications, modules/emergencysnapshot/http, modules/mealplan/http, modules/timetable/compose/httpadapter, modules/workforce/compose/httpadapter) with assertions unchanged: the diff of every switched test file is identical after replacing the testutil/routetest selector.
scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development without --fast over the 131 affected packages, including ./test (ratchets) and every remaining api/testutil importer.
golangci-lint on the 131 affected packages; scripts/check-deadcode.sh.

scripts/backend-architecture.sh check --base-ref <base SHA> with exactly the listed key absent from legacy.jsonl and none added; scripts/backend-architecture.sh validate-ticket --all --base-ref <base SHA>.
